_description: Metadata configuration for documents uploaded to RAG File Search. This allows pre-defining author, subjects, and content types for documents synced from Google Drive.
_usage: Documents listed here will have their metadata applied during sync or re-upload. Use the document filename (case-insensitive) as the key.
_note: For patrag.pdf, we set Patrick Ruff as author since it contains his website posts and journal entries. The subject_of_story field can be left empty for journal/diary content (author is writing about themselves).

patrag.pdf.author: Patrick Ruff
patrag.pdf.description: Patrick Ruff's website posts and personal journal entries

_metadata_fields.author: Who wrote the document (string)
_metadata_fields.subject_of_story: Who the document is about - use for stories about specific people (string or array)
_metadata_fields.content_type: Type of document: journal, story, record, photo, etc. (string)
_metadata_fields.description: Human-readable description (not sent to RAG, just for reference)
